name: Down the Coast
summary: Along Hillsbrad's coast, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle leaves Southshore's defense to passing adventurers. Sent from Stormwind, he would rather drink ale than patrol, even as Torn Fin murlocs gather along the Western Strand.

sections.title: A Reluctant Posting
sections.body: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle left Stormwind's city guard for a post in Southshore. The port feels dreary to him, and he cannot bear the fishy harbor odor. He spends his days drinking at the inn instead of patrolling the frontlines. Marshal Redpath has ordered him to protect Southshore from the dangers nearby, but Orinelle hires passing sellswords to do the work.

sections.title: The Torn Fin Threat
sections.body: The Western Strand runs along the coast west of Southshore. Orinelle scoffs at the murlocs as overgrown fish, but the Torn Fin tribe threatens coastal travel and local shipping. Its tidehunters and oracles gather in camps along the breakers and ambush anyone who strays too far from town walls. Clearing the shoreline means facing them there.

faq.q: Why doesn't Farren Orinelle deal with the murlocs himself?
faq.answer: Farren sees Southshore as an unwanted exile from his former life in Stormwind's city guard. Resentful of his posting and disgusted by the coastal town, he would rather drink ale at the inn than fight murlocs, so he pays adventurers to do the work.

faq.q: Who is 'ol Redpath' mentioned by Orinelle?
faq.answer: He means Marshal Redpath, Southshore's marshal. Redpath is responsible for order and defense in the embattled settlement, and issues military orders that Lieutenant Orinelle tries to evade.

faq.q: Where are the Torn Fin murlocs located?
faq.answer: The Torn Fin murlocs live along the Western Strand, the coastal beaches west of Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What kinds of murlocs need to be eliminated?
faq.answer: The order calls for killing Torn Fin Tidehunters, the tribe's frontline fighters, and Torn Fin Oracles, who use elemental and aquatic magic to aid their kin.

faq.q: What happens after clearing the beach for Orinelle?
aliases: next quest after down the coast
faq.answer: After the sweep, Orinelle sees that he needs evidence to satisfy Marshal Redpath's scrutiny. He then seeks physical proof of the slain murlocs.

faq.q: Is the murloc threat actually serious or just an excuse?
faq.answer: Farren mocks them as harmless overgrown fish, but the Torn Fin are numerous and aggressive, and live close to Southshore's docks. They threaten trade routes and fishermen.

angles.text: As an Alliance soldier, you know Southshore is a key coastal stronghold in the north. Negligence among its garrison can put the town at risk.
As a human, you can see the gulf between Stormwind's sheltered heart and the hard lives of northern settlements in Orinelle's neglect.
